verdict.rationale: The evidence covers sync modes, incremental sync, CDC, schedules and schema-change handling, but nothing documents a per-stream or per-table resync, refresh, reset, or historical backfill that leaves the rest of the connection intact. The one community report on a large table describes a custom workaround that 'tricked' Airbyte, not a product capability. Adjacent sync features earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can backfill history or resync a single table without rebuilding the whole pipeline
